name: held_at
description: The date and time (UTC) a session actually took place.

aiGuidance.purpose: Dates the session whose decisions were ratified or set aside; a session has a date and a time, scheduled or not.
aiGuidance.extraction: RFC 3339 UTC instant of the session start, e.g. 2026-10-10T14:30:00Z.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: Not the decisions' own creation times: those were made between sessions.
